note: Runs only when available RAM is below the target, before a heavy model load. Tries only the apps named here; it does not sweep through the largest apps (set auto_largest to true to allow that). Asks you in a dialog before it closes anything (quit, skip, skip all for 10 minutes, sleep 2 hours, or turn off; no answer in 90 seconds means skip), then sends a normal Quit (save prompts still appear), never force-kills, and reopens the apps in the background after the model unloads. Claude, Codex, terminals, Finder and the security/IT apps are always protected.
